meta.title: Why TenthMatrix: AI agent and generative AI development
meta.description: Why companies outsource AI agent and generative AI projects to TenthMatrix: one team for the agent, integrations and operations, approval gates, and code, data and keys that stay yours.

content.title: AI agents and generative AI applications, built by a team that runs its own
content.description: Companies outsource AI projects to us because we cover the whole job: the agent, the integrations, the security around it and the operations after launch. You keep the code, the data and the final say.

content.title: The agent, the integrations and the operations
content.description: AI projects usually stall on the parts around the model: connecting real systems, keeping keys safe, testing and releasing. We do all of it, so you are not coordinating three suppliers.

content.title: A person approves anything risky
content.description: Our agents draft, research and prepare. Anything that sends, spends or deletes waits for a named person, and every step is logged.

content.title: Your code, your data, your keys
content.description: Code lives in your repository from the first commit. Data stays in your systems. Model keys stay in your secrets store and reach agents through WSL Vault as short-lived credentials.

content.title: Products we use in production
content.description: Ring Promoter, WSL Proxy, WSL Vault and Jobshout started as things our own agents needed. Their documentation and source are public, so your engineers can check how they work.

content.title: Self-hosted or managed, with the model that fits
content.description: Run in your cloud, your data centre or on infrastructure we manage. Use Claude, OpenAI models or open-weight models on your own hardware.

content.title: Hand-over is planned from day one
content.description: Every engagement can end with docs, runbooks and training, whether that is next quarter or years from now. You can take the work in-house whenever you choose.
